title: ACCEPTANCE OF THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY, FEDERAL EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT AGENCY GRANT UNDER FISCAL YEAR 2026 PORT SECURITY GRANT PROGRAM, AWARD NO. EMW-2026-PU-05458

Summary
: Staff requests approval to accept and enter into a Grant Award, Grant No. EMW-2026-PU-05458, with the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), for the reimbursement of funds allocated to the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) under the Fiscal Year (FY) 2026 Port Security Grant Program (PSGP). If approved, the proposed Federal award will be in the amount of $2,312,500 with an award date of September 1, 2026. Items approved for grant reimbursement subsequent to expenditure by the Harbor Department are as follows: the Security System Maintenance project in the amount of $1,000,000, the Underwater Detection System project in the amount of $1,000,000, and the Security System Extended Video Storage project in the amount of $312,500. The award is for a three-year period ending August 31, 2029. A 25% cost share is required under this FY 2026 PSGP, which will be funded by the Harbor Department. The total project cost is $3,083,333. The Harbor Department’s share is $770,833. This agreement is in alignment with Strategic Objective 2: An Efficient, Secure, and Sustainable Supply Chain.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the Grant Award, Grant No. EMW-2026-PU-05458 between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department and the United States Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency for the reimbursement of funds allocated to the Harbor Department under the Fiscal Year 2026 Port Security Grant Program; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the Obligating Document for the Award; 4) authorize the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department to implement the projects approved for funding by the United States Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency; and 5) adopt Resolution No. ____________ accepting the Grant Award, Grant No. EMW-2026-PU-05458, for the reimbursement of funds allocated to the Harbor Department under the FY 2026 PSGP.
